title: Which object is the fossil?

knows: A replica is an object made to resemble another object.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish an original fossil from a replica cast.

misconception: A museum cast is necessarily the original fossil.
objective: Distinguish an original fossil from a replica cast.

claims.text: Museums sometimes show replicas. A museum makes a cast from a fossil mold. Which object is the replica? The cast is a made replica that takes the shape of the mold; the original fossil is the specimen from which the mold was made. A replica can show shape without being the original material.
